verdict.rationale: Gusto Embedded documents a 401(k) offering through its Guideline integration, and partners can generate links for employer payroll admins to reach Guideline via pre-built flows. That covers offering a retirement plan. However, the evidence never explicitly states that 401(k) contributions sync automatically with each payroll run; the closest is a general note that off-cycle payrolls use the same deductions and contributions as regular payrolls. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of automatic per-payroll contribution sync to Guideline, details on employee and employer contribution setup, independent or hands-on corroboration.
